verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own Payment Links as "the easiest way for you to accept payments online without a digital storefront," and its invoicing docs mention generating digital payment links, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence never explicitly says links are created from the dashboard without code. "Start selling immediately" is weakened because onboarding depends on registration location and eligibility criteria that do not guarantee approval, and features vary by region. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of no-code dashboard creation and sharing of links, evidence of instant go-live after signup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
